title: RCP/RCLM Reflective Successor Verification: Papers, Lean Proofs, and Controlled Executable Artifacts
description: Formal and executable RCP/RCLM instantiation package through Formal Core v4 Gate E and Executable Core v4 Phase 14, including the companion papers, Lean projects, Python runtimes, PowerShell and shell tooling, schemas, workflows, controlled artifacts, and retained cross-platform replay evidence. Phase 14 closes a finite, domain-relative, package-bound schedule-free M4-to-M8 trajectory; it does not establish generic successor availability, full Gate E closure, open-horizon or asynchronous RSI, general noncommuting semantics, or empirically unbounded RSI.
